title: Godot + Claude Opus 5.5: the first scenes of my game. How do you like it so far?
author: Organic-Shame-4520
selftext:
Hi all! This is Shelter Yard, a third-person night game I'm making in Godot 4.7. The video shows the first scenes and where development stands right now.

**How it's made**

* **Code, scenes, lighting and effects:** Godot 4.7, with Claude Opus 5.5 as my coding agent.
* **Assets:** made in ComfyUI, plus Fab and Poly Haven.
* **Blender:** assets built and fixed with Astra and Opus 5.5, then exported to Godot.
* **Sounds:** ElevenLabs.

It took a lot of effort. The AI doesn't get things right the first time. I guided it one small step at a time, tested every change in the game, and sent back marked screenshots ("too bright", "too shiny", "it's floating") until it looked right. Some things, like a wall, a lamp or a railing colour, took five or six rounds.

How do you guys like it so far? I'd love your feedback on the mood, the lighting and the camera.

https://reddit.com/link/1ww1wfk/video/p80xvzl0b3th1/player

comments.author: Metalwell
comments.body: Looks good, how much did this cost in total? How would you recommend a newbie to start woth this? I have extensive coding agent system for work but making games are always hard with these tools

replies.author: Organic-Shame-4520
replies.body:
for experiment I took Max 20x: $200, but I never reached the 5 hour or weekly limit. I think Max 5x: $100 would more than enough. I also dont have any experience in blender or any other 3d software. All the work is done by AI. It took me a week to build these scenes.

Tip: move step by step dont ask Claude to build in one go. Research and find what assets you want to use, create reference images, use drawing tool to sketch the map and it give all to Claude and it will do it.

replies.author: Metalwell
replies.body: Thanks a lot. You just rawdogged then, only mcps. No skills etc. amazing work. Looks very good

replies.author: tothjm
replies.body: How much were the apps for assets?  I'm stuck there.. I hear tripo and meshy is the way

replies.author: Organic-Shame-4520
replies.body:
Where I want to create my own models, like gun, torch, backpack, helmet etc.. I use comfyUI local setup on RTX 3080 10 GB card. and it works very well.   
My main experiment was to generate the game with least cost.

replies.author: dotNettr
replies.body: Are you using comfy UI to create reference in mages and then handing them to Claude to make models in blender? I have been playing with comfy as well, letting Claude control it. Mixed bag so far

replies.author: Organic-Shame-4520
replies.body: In comfyUI converting the final model to lowpoly glb format. Then directly use that in  GoDot engine and claude will adjust it. Ask claude to add final node for covert to lowpoly GLB format

comments.author: KvickaN
comments.body: That looks like a start of an AAA game 🔥

replies.author: Organic-Shame-4520
replies.body:
Thanks!   
It took a lot of work building the toolkit and teaching the AI how to model each object properly, compare it against the reference and fix it. In the next version of the experiment I'm using Opus + GPT SOL together, and it's already reaching about 90% accuracy to the reference image. Still improving it. SO no more 3rd party assets.
